title: Study in the USA
tagline: Universities, colleges and language schools. Help with scholarships and the F-1 visa.
intro:
A US education is valued worldwide, and the flexible system lets you choose a path that fits your budget: start at a community college and transfer, or go straight into a bachelor’s or master’s program.

We shortlist schools, prepare essays and documents, help you win scholarships and obtain your I-20, and then the F-1 visa.
services: Shortlisting universities and colleges within budget
Applications via university portals and Common App

sections.heading: Study options
sections.body:
- **Bachelor’s** — 4 years, the first two include general education.
- **Community college** — 2 years, lower cost, then transfer to a university.
- **Master’s** — 1–2 years, requires a bachelor’s degree.
- **Language programs** — intensive English before your main studies.

sections.heading: Scholarships
sections.body: Most scholarships for international students come from universities themselves — for grades, test scores and achievements. A strong essay and a well-chosen list of schools make a real difference to the discount you receive.

documents: School certificate/diploma with grades and translation
For the visa: I-20, SEVIS receipt, DS-160

steps.title: Strategy
steps.text: We assess your profile and build a list of schools.

steps.title: Essays and documents
steps.text: We write essays and collect recommendations and documents.

steps.title: Admission and I-20
steps.text: We choose the best offer and obtain the I-20.

faq.q: Can I study in the USA for free?
faq.a: Full scholarships exist but are extremely competitive. It is more realistic to aim for partial scholarships and choose schools that are generous to international students.
Many universities are test-optional, but a good score can help with scholarships. We decide based on your profile.
F-1 students can work on campus with an hour limit. Off-campus work is only possible with special authorization.

seo_description: Study in the USA for students from Kyrgyzstan: bachelor’s, master’s, community college, scholarships, I-20 and F-1 visa.
